elements.evidence: The clause binds both parties, including Customer, not to solicit specified personnel.

elements.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: The restriction expressly applies to “personnel of the other party directly involved in the Services.”

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
elements.evidence: The clause specifies “for 12 months after their involvement ends.”

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
elements.evidence: The operative prohibition addresses solicitation only and contains no prohibition on hiring.
